description:
Customer reporting internet issues, mobile signal issues, sms issues, home phone connection issues or TV receiver connection problems. They may be experiencing slow speeds, dropped connections, inability to send or receive messages, or other connectivity problems.

The customer reports a specific issue with one of their devices, such as a mobile phone, TV, receiver, modem, or landline. This includes problems with device functionality, error messages, or inability to use the device as expected.
